method: Read all 204 Stage01 propositions, all 47 complete context profiles and 16 exact governor sets against the complete base272–568 section and exact transitive contexts. Every full original payload and all 1227 ordered bindings are verified against immutable evidence and pinned source bytes. Distinguish external humanAuthorityCandidates confirmation from structured fallback, and narrow ask/defer/preservation permissions from actual typed answeredness/current acceptance. Each of seven independent corrections has exact source rationale. Archived proposal inputs are verified in memory against durable regular-member custody. Final outputs use bounded staging and a lossless durable archive; no implementation, tests or proof results were consulted.

decisions.PRESERVED_INITIAL_AND_STORAGE: Every exact initially supplied input form, verbatim human text, once-stored actual file bytes, actual byte hash/length, application-owned occurrence identity, controlled version and authorized retention duty remains. C/C1 preserves originals and distinct supplied occurrences while allowing blob sharing. No prior arbitrary semantic extraction is invented.
decisions.EXACT_INTAKE_GOVERNOR: Every caption retains its exact actor, condition, scope, list domain and individual governed IDs/ranges. The browser-local/external-custody premise retains both exact disjoint governed ranges without inventing another operation. New inserted clauses are not absorbed into the original occurrence set; each changed child is independently accounted.
decisions.PRESERVED_FIRST_READER_BOUNDARY: Stage01 remains the first semantic extraction stage and cannot assume earlier agent extraction. Mechanical structural unitization is not arbitrary semantic understanding. No hidden intake actor or later-stage authority is introduced.
decisions.PRESERVED_TRANSFER_AND_CUSTODY: The exact artifact identity, filename, actual hash, byte availability and transfer instruction remain, with each no-recreation/retyping/redescription/different-copy/manual-package/hash/file-selection prohibition. Stored bytes must be used. F2 attributable echoes do not establish external possession, independence or actual inspection; C1 does not alter transport.
decisions.PRESERVED_HANDOFF_SHAPE: The authoritative prompt file and exact operator attach/share path remain, without mandatory prompt copying, file-body pasting, manual package reconstruction or reselection of stored bytes. C1 leaves this transport intact. Actual complete current file membership is a separate changed obligation.
decisions.PRESERVED_REUSE: No repeated human attachment or semantic resupply is required merely to rediscover accepted information. Exact stored artifact identities remain available when bytes matter. Current intake/input and mapping content is reviewed separately; local custody is not external possession.
decisions.PRESERVED_HUMAN_CAPTURE_BOUNDARY: External conversation, exact extracted answer display, provenance creation, no-retyping confirmation, correction-triggered replacement and EXTERNAL_CLAIM status before confirmation remain. The humanAuthorityCandidates confirmation path is distinct from the humanInputRequests fallback and cannot be silently replaced by its writer or controls.
decisions.PRESERVED_ACCOUNTING_OWNERSHIP: The two accounting/extraction layers and each named application raw-accounting or agent semantic-extraction responsibility remain. C/C1 changes unit definitions and complete coverage, not ownership. Application structural counts do not establish semantic understanding or current complete inspection.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_BOUNDARY: Every exact later-stage research/ranking/atomization/test/design/production/filing/simulation/manufacturing/deployment/verification exclusion remains, including rejection when such work replaces intake. Structural decoding adds no substantive stage authority.
decisions.PRESERVED_QUESTION_CATEGORIES: The exclusive three question categories, human-needed-to-define criterion, foreseeable ask-now requirement, no asking merely because unknown, tracked later path and no skip-through-nonblocking rule remain. A optional fallback cannot waive a governing human issue; no normal conversation is required to become typed fallback.
decisions.PRESERVED_HUMAN_CONVERSATION: Questions remain normal concise conversation. Every prohibition on asking for machine JSON/schema/field names, IDs/relationships/hashes or repeated/accessibly available/researchable information remains. Typed controls govern the optional final fallback route, not ordinary conversational content.
decisions.PRESERVED_HUMAN_AUTHORITY: Exact human confirmation, external-response pointer, value, receipt and input-version duties remain. An agent cannot create or modify HUMAN/HUMAN_DECISION authority. A request affected-field/family names convey context only, and its fallback scope cannot replace the distinct external humanAuthorityCandidates confirmation path.
decisions.PRESERVED_SUBJECT_NEUTRALITY: Every prohibited runtime project-subject branch remains prohibited; a subject fixture grants no subject-specific production branch. Generic derivation still uses actual project inputs without invented domain behavior.
decisions.PRESERVED_COMPLETION_BOUNDARIES: The fixed current-input existence, defined objective/deliverable, required-field presence, no later-stage work, exact confirmation current-input/accepted-change links, no compulsory line-by-line reconstruction and genuine-human-decision-only boundaries remain. Actual current material/issue coverage and proposal acceptance are separately changed.
decisions.CURRENT_RAW_INVENTORY_AND_HANDOFF: Actual inventory, mechanically available locations, complete raw-artifact handoff and smallest exact later transfer consume C/C1 exact distinct occurrences, additive physical/structural/textual units, verified child bytes and retained originals. Supported subdivisions cannot be hidden as unsupported and unknown remainders cannot become zero. IDs, blob sharing, custody and transport authority remain.
decisions.CURRENT_EXHAUSTIVE_READING_AND_EXTRACTIO: The actual exhaustive first-reader and every independently named extraction/omission category now operate over C/C1 exact retained source occurrences and authorized subdivisions, including blank/BOM/terminator bytes, metadata and child content. A current valid fallback answers contribute human source context only when that route is used; optional unanswered requests assert no fact. Structural coverage does not prove every semantic implication.
decisions.CURRENT_INTAKE_ACCEPTANCE_AND_COVERAGE: Actual current reusable intake, file inspection/support, provenance, two-pass coverage, resolved omissions and proposal readiness consume C/C1 exact complete unit accounting and applicable A fallback validity, with F2 minimum external input-basis support. INCLUDED_IN_HANDOFF remains application fact; semantic inspection retains its recorded basis. Material/inaccessible content or required authority is not waived.
decisions.CURRENT_HUMAN_INPUT_SOURCE: Later prompts consume the current UserJobInput, including applicable A canonically valid fallback answers and existing input-version/invalidation lifecycle. Optional unanswered requests contribute no factual assertion. Canonical input ownership/source selection and ordinary external confirmation remain intact.
decisions.CURRENT_COVERAGE_MAPPING_SOURCE: Later source-location/coverage mappings consume C/C1 exact occurrence, unit kind, locator, source-value hash and unit universe, retaining original parents/distinct child occurrences/inaccessible nodes. Mapping establishes neither semantic inspection nor external custody; applicable ZIP inherited-reference interpretation needs explicit attributed linkage.
decisions.CURRENT_CONFIRMED_OR_COACCEPTED_ANSWER: The external humanAuthorityCandidates confirmation writer and value rules remain distinct from A fallback controls. Atomic co-acceptance also validates the dependent current response, whose required humanInputRequests array now follows A. This does not make the confirmed external value a fallback answer or require SAVE_HUMAN_INPUT for its separate confirmation transaction.
decisions.CURRENT_ANSWEREDNESS_AND_DEFERRAL: Actual required answeredness must account for A valid typed fallback answers when a fallback is used: missing blocking answers reject, values must satisfy the control, and optional unanswered requests assert no fact. Ordinary conversation and explicit unknown/deferred preservation remain intact; neither a new representation nor typed factual coercion is invented. Narrow ask/defer and preservation permissions are separately corrected as retained.
decisions.CURRENT_MATERIAL_RESOLVABILITY: Whether available material can establish an issue consumes C/C1 actual retained/verified subdivisions and inaccessible/blocked outcomes. Do not ignore available supported content or fabricate unavailable content. Authorized research/later-stage paths and avoiding needless human questions remain unchanged.
decisions.CURRENT_GENERIC_QUESTION_DERIVATION: Actual question derivation uses C/C1 exact current request/material/source context and unresolved coverage, plus A current request/answer constraints only where the fallback route applies. Preserve subject neutrality and normal conversation. Optional requests cannot waive material authority or create facts; technical uncertainties are not reassigned to humans without source basis.
decisions.CORRECTION_310: Base365 and1170–1172 govern humanAuthorityCandidates external-conversation confirmation, which creates HUMAN or HUMAN_DECISION authority with exact provenance. A successor1648–1650 governs humanInputRequests fallback answers through SAVE_HUMAN_INPUT. It does not replace the distinct confirmation writer or require its externally reported value to become a typed fallback answer. Retain the exact authority-creation proposition and source occurrences.
decisions.CORRECTION_312: Retain the separate §14.10 exact-confirmation authority and all-or-neither ordering at base1172. Atomic co-acceptance also validates the dependent current response, whose required closed humanInputRequests array is newly governed by A successor1639–1648, even when empty. Therefore current co-acceptance context changes, but the external humanAuthorityCandidates value itself is not a fallback answer and its writer is not replaced by SAVE_HUMAN_INPUT. Correct the proposal rationale while retaining a fresh changed identity.
decisions.CORRECTION_338: Base408 rejects when a required human-only issue was neither asked nor explicitly deferred. This is the ask/defer guard, not a typed-answer validity predicate. Base365/523/1533 retain normal external conversation and structured fallback only as fallback. A1646 preserves governing requirements and does not redefine whether an issue was asked or explicitly deferred. Keep exact original context and occurrence set.
decisions.CORRECTION_438: Base504 expressly permits the human to answer unknown or deferred for ASK_NOW_NONBLOCKING. A closes fallback factual-answer validation only; it does not revoke this conversational permission or coerce these words into another control. Preserve this exact permission with the original question-class contexts.
decisions.CORRECTION_439: Base505 permits Stage01 completion after the explicit unknown/deferred answer in the ASK_NOW_NONBLOCKING class. This limited permission remains subject to all independent completion duties and does not assert complete current acceptance. A does not remove the permission or force unknown/deferred into a typed factual answer; retain its exact conditional context.
decisions.CORRECTION_444: Base514 requires preserving the human answer unknown or deferred. A exact typed fallback rules do not change this preservation duty, authorize coercion or require a new answer representation. Keep the original human statement and tracked unresolved issue under its exact source contexts.
decisions.CORRECTION_447: Base517 permits progression with a tracked unresolved item when needed only later and the human already had an opportunity to answer. A optional-fallback/default rules do not erase that specific deferral permission or waive other completion obligations. Retain the exact timing/opportunity/tracking predicate; actual fallback answeredness and full current acceptance remain separate changed duties.

qualifier: The separately accepted technical-reference interpretation resolves policy meaning in its exact attributed scope. These historical reference qualifiers are preserved pending explicit per-entry effective-dependency and typed-governor linkage review; they are not a claim that the normative input remains missing or an automatic scope-wide identity change.
